ROLE.description: Role and permission hierarchy managed as a DAG (dag.dll). Roles inherit from parent roles — admin > moderator > member > guest. Custom per-app roles attach as leaf nodes.
ROLE.tokens: role permission access admin moderator member guest hierarchy inherit grant privilege scope level

fold_ops.Pop: load role DAG from dag.dll; cache role hierarchy in memory
fold_ops.Wo: normalize role name; look up node in DAG; resolve inherited permissions
fold_ops.Yax: evaluate which parent roles apply for a given user+app pair
fold_ops.Sek: emit role result or permission verdict
fold_ops.Ch'en: verify no privilege escalation; confirm role edge is valid
fold_ops.Xul: emit read-only role response; no topology mutation

PROFILE.description: OAuth-populated user profile document. Created on first login; updated on subsequent logins. Stored as BSON via MongoDB.Bson.dll.
PROFILE.tokens: profile user name email avatar bio photo identity account person details member

fold_ops.Pop: connect to MongoDB; ensure users.profiles collection index (email, user_id)
fold_ops.Wo: deserialize BSON profile document; validate required fields
fold_ops.Yax: merge incoming OAuth fields with existing profile (last_seen, name changes)
fold_ops.Sek: upsert profile document via MongoDB.Bson BSON serializer
fold_ops.Ch'en: verify user_id uniqueness; confirm email is not already claimed by different provider
fold_ops.Xul: emit profile record or upsert confirmation

TABLE.description: Denormalized user document combining profile, role, session refs, and app memberships. Hot path — served from json_runtime_lib in-process cache; MongoDB is the persistence layer.
TABLE.tokens: table user record document denormalized cache query list lookup fast index user_id email

fold_ops.Pop: init json_runtime cache; load hot users from MongoDB into LRU
fold_ops.Wo: resolve lookup key (user_id or email); check json_runtime cache
fold_ops.Yax: on cache miss: query MongoDB users.table; deserialize via json_runtime_lib
fold_ops.Sek: return cached or freshly-loaded user document
fold_ops.Ch'en: validate document schema; check last_seen freshness
fold_ops.Xul: emit user table record; update LRU cache timestamp

MEMORY.description: Per-user persistent key-value memory store. Each memory entry carries a category and importance weight. Semantic search uses GEMMA-µ embed when available.
MEMORY.tokens: memory remember fact store key value recall user data preference history context note

fold_ops.Wo: parse memory key and category; normalize to lowercase
fold_ops.Yax: SELECT strategy: direct-key lookup vs. category scan vs. semantic search
fold_ops.Sek: execute read or write via MongoDB.Bson; on semantic mode → delegate to GEMMA-µ embed
fold_ops.Ch'en: verify user_id ownership; check importance range [0.0–1.0]
fold_ops.Xul: emit memory value or write confirmation

MICRONAUTS.description: Capability grant registry — maps (user_id, micronaut_id) → allowed_keys[]. Grant graph stored in dag.dll; each node is a user, each edge is a capability delegation to a micronaut.
MICRONAUTS.tokens: micronauts capabilities access grant revoke delegate permissions service resource atomic key allowed user assign

fold_ops.Pop: load grant graph from dag.dll; build user→micronaut adjacency
fold_ops.Wo: resolve user_id + micronaut_id pair; look up grant node in DAG
fold_ops.Yax: if allowed_keys is empty → all keys permitted; otherwise intersect with requested key
fold_ops.Sek: emit boolean access verdict + allowed key list
fold_ops.Ch'en: verify grant was issued by admin or owner; confirm micronaut exists in registry
fold_ops.Xul: emit access result; update grant timestamp on successful check

SESSIONS.description: Session token lifecycle. Tokens are 32-byte random base64 strings with expiry. OAuth tokens from oauth_bindings are referenced here; this layer handles creation, validation, and revocation.
SESSIONS.tokens: session token oauth login auth expiry refresh logout access active valid user identity sign in

fold_ops.Pop: init session cache (json_runtime); load non-expired sessions from MongoDB
fold_ops.Wo: hash-lookup session token in json_runtime cache; fallback to MongoDB query
fold_ops.Yax: evaluate expiry: compare expires_at vs. UtcNow; check OAuth token validity if bound
fold_ops.Sek: emit session valid/invalid + user_id; on new session: generate token, persist
fold_ops.Ch'en: validate token format (base64 44 chars); confirm user exists in users.table
fold_ops.Xul: emit session record or validation result; revoke clears cache + DB

LOG.description: Automatic audit trail of every prompt sent and response received, keyed to user_id + session_token. Pattern.Log.dll writes append-only entries; json_runtime_lib provides fast tail-reads for context injection. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure via Remove-UserPatternLog.
LOG.tokens: log prompt response history conversation audit trail interaction record replay search pattern context

fold_ops.Pop: init Pattern.Log.dll; open append-only log handle for users.patterns collection
fold_ops.Wo: parse log entry type (prompt/response/system/error); validate user_id + session
fold_ops.Yax: SELECT strategy: append (write path) vs. range-read vs. full-text search vs. semantic search
fold_ops.Sek: execute: Pattern.Log.dll append on write; json_runtime_lib tail-read on get; GEMMA-µ embed on search
fold_ops.Ch'en: verify user_id ownership on reads; confirm erasure targets only the requesting user's data
fold_ops.Xul: emit log confirmation or search results; flush Pattern.Log write buffer

phase_contract.Pop: load drivers (MongoDB.Bson, dag.dll, json_runtime_lib, Pattern.Log); verify backend reachability
phase_contract.Wo: parse + normalize all seven ⟁USER:* resource keys; auth check on session token
phase_contract.Yax: strategy selection per resource: cache vs. DB vs. semantic vs. graph
phase_contract.Sek: execute the selected strategy; write results to cache; return structured response
phase_contract.Ch'en: validate data integrity; check authorization; confirm no privilege escalation
phase_contract.Xul: emit response to caller; update denormalized users.table if profile or role changed
